limitations: Threshold disagreement in low/best/high estimates measures operational sensitivity of the >=25 UCDP-coded target. Named estimates may be nonmonotonic; the threshold envelope is the union of their three indicator values. It is not a statistical confidence level, an estimate of all real violence, or model performance. Revised country-year observations are not independent. Historic 2011+ risksets preserve the 196 first-issued GWNOs; no 2027 labels are observed or scored.
